subject: Relation Extraction
source_sentence: Relation Extraction (RE) is the task of extracting instances of semantic relations between entities in unstructured data such as natural language text.
title: SCHN ¨APPER: A Web Toolkit for Exploratory Relation Extraction

subject: rule-based
source_sentence: One line of approaches to RE are rule-based, where users manually define rule-sets consisting of extraction patterns that if observed point to instances of a relation.
title: SCHN ¨APPER: A Web Toolkit for Exploratory Relation Extraction

subject: extraction patterns
source_sentence: Users explore a corpus for information by selecting and composing extraction patterns.
title: SCHN ¨APPER: A Web Toolkit for Exploratory Relation Extraction
